metrics.definition: v1: actual search invocations at instrumented trie key, phrase-token, feature-hash, feature-integer and vocabulary-canonicalization APIs during parsing; excludes setup
metrics.name: lookup_calls

metrics.definition: v1: instrumented lookup_calls whose exact key was present; phrase-token hit means at least one new phrase emitted
metrics.name: lookup_hits

metrics.definition: v1: instrumented lookup_calls whose exact key was absent; phrase-token miss means no new phrase emitted
metrics.name: lookup_misses

metrics.definition: v1: executed instrumented searches repeating the same dictionary pointer, operation semantics, and exact query bytes within one address; excludes first occurrence; null if identity table overflows
metrics.name: repeated_queries

metrics.definition: v1: logical queries answered without a new search at exact same-address batch deduplication sites; excludes first-use precomputed/direct IDs
metrics.name: answers_reused

metrics.definition: v1: state and transition feature strings present at the scorer boundary; excludes intermediate copies
metrics.name: feature_keys_materialized

metrics.definition: v1: bytes in state and transition feature strings at the scorer boundary; excludes NUL terminators and intermediate copies
metrics.name: feature_key_bytes_materialized

metrics.definition: v1: carried state-word IDs consumed directly during feature generation without rebuilding and searching the feature key
metrics.name: direct_word_ids_consumed

metrics.definition: v1: direct state-word ID path entered its original string-key fallback during feature generation
metrics.name: direct_word_fallbacks

metrics.definition: v1: carried state-word IDs offered to feature generation from the context record
metrics.name: direct_word_ids_offered

metrics.definition: v1: input address bytes passed to parser, excluding line terminators
metrics.name: input_bytes

metrics.definition: v1: normalized address bytes emitted by the instrumented normalization boundary, excluding NUL
metrics.name: normalized_bytes

metrics.definition: v1: tokens emitted by the instrumented tokenizer during parsing
metrics.name: tokens

metrics.definition: v1: response bytes produced at the instrumented response-build boundary; excludes terminator
metrics.name: output_bytes

metrics.definition: unavailable: no complete count of intermediate lookup key construction sites
metrics.name: keys_constructed

metrics.definition: unavailable: parser text copy/append sites are not comprehensively instrumented
metrics.name: bytes_copied

metrics.definition: v1: malloc/calloc/realloc calls made in instrumented address_parser.c and crf.c source bodies during parsing; excludes setup, other translation units, and diagnostic tracker
metrics.name: allocation_calls

metrics.definition: v1: requested bytes for instrumented address_parser.c and crf.c malloc/calloc/realloc calls; realloc counts full new size, excludes setup and diagnostic tracker
metrics.name: allocation_requested_bytes

metrics.definition: unavailable: parser buffer capacity growth sites are not comprehensively instrumented
metrics.name: buffer_growths

metrics.definition: unavailable: lookup probe slots are not counted consistently across trie, hash and integer structures
metrics.name: hash_probes

metrics.definition: unavailable: phrase-trie edge transitions are not instrumented
metrics.name: trie_edges

metrics.definition: v1: state and transition feature weight rows visited at instrumented accumulation sites
metrics.name: model_rows

metrics.definition: v1: state and transition feature weight contributions added at instrumented accumulation sites
metrics.name: weights_accumulated

metrics.definition: v1: cpi-only EXP_PS_FLAGS prefix/suffix per-token filter checks; unavailable for original and prototype181 builds where this path is not enabled
metrics.name: filter_checks

metrics.definition: v1: cpi-only EXP_PS_FLAGS prefix/suffix searches skipped by those checks; unavailable for original and prototype181 builds where this path is not enabled
metrics.name: searches_avoided

metrics.definition: unavailable: use direct_word_fallbacks for the instrumented prototype181 path
metrics.name: fallback_calls

metrics.definition: v1: exact repeated search calls counted before per-address query identity table overflow; lower bound if overflow occurs
metrics.name: tracked_repeated_queries

metrics.definition: v1: actual search calls for which exact per-address query identity could not be retained due to table capacity
metrics.name: untracked_lookup_calls

metrics.definition: v1: no-search answer reuses for which exact per-address query identity could not be retained due to table capacity
metrics.name: untracked_answer_reuses

metrics.definition: v1: peak bytes of dynamically allocated exact-query and retained-pattern key storage; excludes static arrays and allocator metadata
metrics.name: diagnostic_tracker_peak_bytes
